row_grain: One sourced observation of one metric and period per row. Annual, quarterly, YTD, snapshots and targets remain distinct.
encoding: UTF-8; standard comma-delimited CSV with double-quote escaping
missing_values: Blank CSV cells / null JSON values mean unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

fields.observation_id: Stable hash of metric, frequency, reporting dates and source URL. A source revision has a new ID.
fields.metric_id: Stable series identifier. Differently dimensioned financial facts remain separate series.
fields.description: Definition and practical interpretation of the metric.
fields.included_in_web_view: true for an operating KPI shown on the website; false for download-only disclosures.
fields.unit: Unit of value. USD means dollars, USD millions means millions of dollars, percent means percentage points of level (31.1 means 31.1%, not 0.311).
fields.frequency: quarter=standalone quarterly disclosure; annual=full fiscal year; ytd=cumulative fiscal year to date; instant=point-in-time; ttm=trailing twelve months; event/period=irregular disclosure. For operating snapshots, frequency can describe reporting cadence; a missing start date must not be assumed to mean a flow.
fields.period: Source period label. For guidance this may identify the announcement vintage.
fields.start_date: ISO 8601 beginning of measured interval if supplied by source extraction; blank when unavailable or a snapshot.
fields.end_date: ISO 8601 reporting date, interval end or announcement date. Forecast observations can use the announcement date.
fields.fiscal_year: Fiscal-year label inferred only for standard quarter-end dates in recurring series. Workday fiscal year ends January 31.
fields.fiscal_quarter: 1=April, 2=July, 3=October, 4=January. Blank for annual series or nonstandard dates.
fields.value: Numeric disclosed value in unit. Qualifiers must be retained; bounds are not exact measurements.
fields.qualifier: Disclosure qualifier, e.g. ≥, >, < or ≈. Blank means no qualifier was supplied.
fields.observation_kind: actual, estimate, or forecast. Describes the disclosure, not the reliability of a prediction.
fields.is_derived: true when the value is calculated from reported amounts, such as annual less nine-month cash flow. false otherwise.
fields.target_period: Forward target period if explicitly present in the source data; otherwise blank. Also inspect period and notes for target context.
fields.YoY_percent_or_pp: Year-on-year percent growth, or percentage-point change for rate metrics. See growth_unit.
fields.prior_YoY_percent_or_pp: Year-on-year comparison one year before this observation, on the same period basis.
fields.growth_unit: percent or percentage_points. Specifies units for YoY and prior YoY.
fields.acceleration_pp: Latest YoY change minus prior YoY change. For rate metrics, difference between successive annual percentage-point moves.
fields.long_term: Longest available two- to six-year CAGR or annualized rate-point change. Actual horizon is labeled; blank when not comparable.
fields.long_term_basis: Exact calculation label, including horizon and CAGR versus annualized percentage-point change.
fields.long_term_start_date: Start observation date used by the long-term calculation.
fields.growth_unavailable_reason: Reason growth is unavailable, such as a bound, forecast, nonpositive base or missing comparison.
fields.source_url: Primary numerical evidence, often with an inline XBRL fact or PDF-page anchor.
fields.secondary_source_url: Second source used to derive a value, if applicable.
fields.source_type: Source classification if supplied; see source_url and notes for detail.
fields.filed_date: SEC filing date if available. This differs from the economic reporting date.
fields.dimensions_json: JSON-encoded filing dimension members. Do not sum across overlapping dimensional scopes.
fields.comparability_note: Metric-level definition, scope or comparability caveats.
fields.notes: Observation-level context, restatement or derivation notes.
fields.as_of: Research cutoff date. This is a static snapshot, not a live data feed.

files.metrics.csv: All operating and financial disclosures, including standard statements, accounting footnotes and financial guidance.
files.operating-metrics.csv: Only the operating KPI set shown in the website. Same columns.
files.all-disclosures.json: Full nested metric definitions and observations, units, growth and provenance.

usage: Filter frequency=quarter for standalone quarters; do not combine YTD and standalone quarterly rows.
Preserve units, qualifiers, dimensions and source links when comparing or aggregating.
Use observation_kind to separate forecasts from actuals. Fiscal labels for guidance are not necessarily the target period.
Descriptions repeat in CSV for self-contained rows; nested JSON stores the definition once per metric.
Quarterly values are used where disclosed or defensibly derived. Missing quarters and annuals are not estimated; EPS and margins are not derived by subtracting annual figures.
Growth calculation blanks are deliberate; inspect growth_unavailable_reason.
gaps: Prepared remarks for Q2 FY24 through Q1 FY25 not located in primary-source archive.
Q&A portion of earnings calls not transcribed from primary webcast.
No assumed three-year history for newly introduced agents or ad hoc operating disclosures.
Product attach rates have 2023, 2024 and 2025 July snapshots; 2026 analyst day had not yet occurred at October 4 cutoff.
Reported threshold observations do not support precise growth rates.
Historical customer satisfaction population changed; organic-agent definition/availability broadened.
July 2023 12-month backlog is not shown in the contemporary release (which used 24-month backlog); filing data may supply retrospective comparison. Do not substitute 24-month backlog for cRPO.

Six-year timeline extends to October 2020. Historical backfill is partial: selected 2020–2022 total backlog disclosures and FY2023–Q1 FY2024 investor-presentation operating snapshots. Missing older quarters and other KPI histories are not estimated.

This is a broad inventory of investment-relevant recurring metrics and selected one-off disclosures, not literally every numeral (e.g. slide numbers, executive tenure, illustrative hypothetical contracts).
Main annual subscription and margin guidance from August 2023 onward included; detailed services, OCF, capex and next-quarter guidance before Q2 FY2025 are not exhaustively transcribed.
Some sporadic operating metrics have one observation and no disclosed three-year comparable series. These must display insufficient history rather than invented growth.
2026 analyst day scheduled October 13, after October 4 cutoff, so no 2026 analyst-day figures included.
TAM methodology/product coverage evolves. Market estimates should not be treated as booked revenue or direct business growth.

FY28 framework announced September 2025 is a historical vintage. Latest August 2026 preliminary FY28 outlook is approximately 11% annual subscription growth and at least two points of non-GAAP margin expansion; see separately labeled current targets.
Selected Q&A disclosures are provided separately from secondary verbatim transcripts. Coverage ledger lists exact sources; this is not a completeness certification.
Primary audio replay was not transcribed independently. Secondary Q&A sources are labeled.
Bank-conference Q&A and analyst-day spoken Q&A beyond slides not exhaustively reviewed.
Illustrative customer-level ROI metrics do not establish Workday-wide performance; bases, sample sizes and validation are often undisclosed.
Numbers from analyst questions were excluded unless confirmed by management.
Repeated financial and AI figures already captured from primary sources excluded to avoid duplicates.
Q2 FY27 secondary transcript contains an erroneous subscription revenue amount and conflicting internal-agent counts. Official filing/remarks used instead; conflicting Q&A count excluded.

This dataset exhaustively inventories numeric inline XBRL facts in 15 financial filings; untagged prose disclosures, earnings call Q&A, presentations, proxy tables and embedded images require separate review.
Dimensional series are kept separate. YTD series must never be compared directly with standalone quarters.
Company tags may change over time and are not automatically stitched to differently named tags.
Some footnote metrics are reported once or annually, so three-year histories and comparable growth rates are unavailable.

Numeric untagged narrative and duration/date facts encoded as nonNumeric XBRL are outside this numeric dataset; non-GAAP release reconciliations, guidance, customer/ARR/retention/seat KPIs and call-only operating statistics require the companion operating dataset.
Reported filing facts are not guaranteed to be economically meaningful KPIs; the inventory includes technical accounting and disclosure inputs.
